findings.evidence: In AdicSystem.lean the only simp lemma for `limQuotientEquiv` is `limQuotientEquiv_mk` (line 212), which needs a `Submodule.Quotient.mk` representative; the proof never introduces one, so the step `simp` takes is not visible.
findings.fix: Pick a representative first: `obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := reductionπ_surjective I F.lim k x`, then close with `simp [reductionLimEquiv_reductionπ, transitionOfLE_reductionπ]` (or `transition_limπ`) in place of the rw chain.
findings.issue: `reductionLimIso` naturality: an eight-step `rw` chain (`LinearMap.comp_apply` ×2, `ModuleCat.hom_comp` ×2, `LinearEquiv.toModuleIso_hom` ×2, `ModuleCat.hom_ofHom` ×2) is followed by a bare `simp` on an arbitrary quotient element `x`, which hides why the components commute with the transitions.

findings.evidence: Diff lines in `ofLimHom`: `rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply (F.transition n), transition_comp_limπ, ofLimHomApp_limπ, ofLimHomApp_limπ, ← LinearMap.comp_apply (G.transition n), transition_comp_limπ]`.
findings.fix: Use or add a pointwise lemma `transition (limπ (n+1) x) = limπ n x` and close with `simp [ofLimHomApp_limπ]`.
findings.issue: `ofLimHom` naturality is a chain of named rewrites (`← LinearMap.comp_apply (F.transition n)`, `transition_comp_limπ`, `ofLimHomApp_limπ` ×2, `← LinearMap.comp_apply (G.transition n)`, `transition_comp_limπ`) that breaks on renames.

summary: Proofs are mostly robust, and the definitional-equality steps are commented. The naturality proofs of `reductionLimIso` and `ofLimHom` use brittle rewrite chains, and `reductionLimIso` also closes its goal with an opaque `simp` that never picks a representative.
